## Use

Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

A radically minimal, blank-canvas interface built as an edge-to-edge surface,
with almost no color and typography carrying the visual weight. Black is the
only filled color, divider, and surface tone for cards above the page. All
interactive elements use pill-shaped geometry for a soft, conversational feel.
Image-based cards use a precise radius for near-flat contrast. The UI has no
shadows, gradients, or decorative illustrations. Color appears only through
editorial photography.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, minimal, clean
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=Open Sans, display=Open
  Sans, mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800,
  900
- Color palette: primary, secondary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#000000, secondary=#ffffff, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Radically minimal blank-canvas interface where black carries structure and
typography drives hierarchy.
